| Deploy on Maul. Adds 1 to Maul's lightsaber combat total. May lose 1 Force to add 2 to Force drain where present. Twice per battle, may target a character. Draw two destiny. ! Lore
| Maul's double-bladed lightsaber is two lightsabers fused into one that requires years of training to {{Errata hl|1=weld properly}}.
